title: Research: over 53M people in China worked as food delivery or ridesharing drivers as of 2025, up 10M in two years, amid accelerating automation in manufacturing (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Research: over 53M people in China worked as food delivery or ridesharing drivers as of 2025, up 10M in two years, amid accelerating automation in manufacturing — As construction slumps and manufacturing automates, 53mn Chinese now work for low wages in food delivery and ride-hailing.
